ruling: v3 is a capability EXTENSION on 8 of 10 released linker prompts and an ACCELERATION on 2. The rule -- a composite is an acceleration if every constituent is individually rankable -- has two different answers here, and the TRANSITION-level one governs. Both are reported: the action-level result is universal and explains why, the transition-level result decides the classification. Neither alone is the finding.

action_level.statement: v3 executes BondReroute(a=path_atom, b=far_anchor, u=new_atom, v=far_anchor), whose moved endpoint u is NOT an endpoint of the cut. The model's graft is a restricted reroute in which the moved atom IS a cut endpoint, so this exact ACTION is unavailable.

transition_level.statement: Compared on the successor MOLECULE -- two actions reaching the same molecule are the same transition to everything downstream -- the exchange is recovered on 2 of 10 and missing on 8, at a budget derived from the measured per-draw rate and again at a 16,384-draw cap.

not_a_missing_family: bond_reroute fires at 0.3 to 13% of draws at these very states and reaches 7 to 64 distinct successors. What is missing is a COORDINATE CLASS, not a family.

the_trade.in_support_route: v2 close-then-open: ring-close the new atom to the far core, then open the original bond. Reaches a length-2 linker on 4 of 10 drugs by hand; needs the far anchor to carry two external bonds at once, which a declared site offering one free valence cannot.
the_trade.reaching_route: v3 insert-then-reroute: atomic bridge exchange, no transient valence, two events instead of three. Reaches a length-2 linker on 10 of 10 drugs by hand, and is outside the proposal law's support on 8.

unexplained: ERLOTINIB recovers because the model offers to move the far-core anchor (100 of 520 reroutes), the only model-shaped route to that molecule. LIOTHYRONINE recovers with the far anchor moved ZERO times, so a second route exists that this evidence does not identify. Recorded as unexplained rather than folded into the first mechanism.

evidence.weakest_negative: MARIBAVIR drew 11 bond_reroutes in 4,000 census draws, so its census negative is the weakly powered one; the escalating scoring probe is the instrument for it and has not yet reported.
